translations.web: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
translations.bsb: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.
translations.kjv: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
translations.asv: And now, my little children, abide in him; that, if he shall be manifested, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
